messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++11 code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

<perturbed_code_1>
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>

using namespace std;

typedef long long int LL;

const LL MOD = 1e9+7;

LL qp(LL p,LL x) { LL ans = 1; for(int i=0;i<x;++i) ans = (ans*p)%MOD; return ans; }

LL solve(LL p,LL k)
{
    if(k<=1) return qp(p,p-1+k);
    int ord = 1;
    for(LL now=k;now!=1;++ord) now = (now*k)%p;
    return qp(p,(p-1)/ord);
}

int main(void)
{
    LL p,k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    cout << solve(p,k) << endl;
    return 0;
}

</perturbed_code_1>
